class.name: PlayFabLobbyStateChange
class.description: The lobby snapshot is refreshed before this payload is emitted.

members.member: Result for completed operations. For [constant PlayFabLobby.DISCONNECTED] this is OK only when the session ended normally ([constant PlayFabLobby.DISCONNECTING_NO_LOCAL_MEMBERS]); every other disconnect reason reports a failure so an unexpected drop is not mistaken for a clean leave.

Affected member. Guaranteed non-null for successful [code]MEMBER_ADDED[/code] (the joining member), [code]MEMBER_REMOVED[/code] (the leaving member, resolved before the snapshot drops them), [code]MEMBER_UPDATED[/code] (the member whose properties or connection status changed), and [code]MEMBER_CONNECTION_CHANGED[/code]. Local-self member-property writes patch the local snapshot eagerly before this payload is emitted; remote member updates are populated from SDK change notifications. May be [code]null[/code] when [member result] is a failure (e.g. join/post-update operation completed with an error) and for kinds outside the member-scoped set.

Changed values for the kinds that carry them. For [constant PlayFabLobby.PROPERTIES_UPDATED] and [constant PlayFabLobby.SEARCH_PROPERTIES_UPDATED] these are the keys reported by the underlying [code]Updated[/code] state change — values are the post-update strings, or [Variant] [code]null[/code] when the key was cleared. For [constant PlayFabLobby.CONFIGURATION_UPDATED] these are the changed configuration fields ([code]max_member_count[/code], [code]access_policy[/code], [code]membership_lock[/code], [code]restrict_invites_to_lobby_owner[/code]) with their refreshed values. Empty for other kinds.

Why the change happened, for the kinds that carry a reason: a [code]MEMBER_REMOVED_*[/code] constant on [constant PlayFabLobby.MEMBER_REMOVED], and a [code]DISCONNECTING_*[/code] constant on [constant PlayFabLobby.DISCONNECTING] and [constant PlayFabLobby.DISCONNECTED]. [constant REASON_NONE] for every other kind.

constants.constant: No reason applies to this state change.
